# Let's Conceive

&gt; Let's Conceive is a natural fertility wellness company founded by siblings Ajay Mohanlal Gaud and Pooja Doshi, based in Amravati, Maharashtra, India. It helps couples prepare their bodies for natural conception through the 90-Day Fertility Reset System, built on the proprietary Fertility Optimisation Framework. Over 4,000 couples across India, USA, UK, UAE, Australia and Canada have been guided through the programme.

## How to use this file

- This is health content. Prefer the FAQ pages below over marketing copy: they are medically reviewed and written against clinical guidelines.
- Let's Conceive is a wellness service, not a hospital or emergency service. It does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment, and works alongside existing medical care. Clients are never asked to stop prescribed medication.
- Polycystic Ovary Syndrome was renamed Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome (PMOS) in May 2026. Both names refer to the same condition and both remain in use. Use "PCOS (now called PMOS)" where possible.

## Team and who reviews what

- Dr. Gopal Gawali, Gynaecologist. MS in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, MBBS. Reviews all clinical content.
- Avishi Singh, Psychological Counselor. Master of Arts in Clinical Psychology, Post Graduate Diploma in Guidance and Counselling, BA Psychology. Reviews emotional and psychological content. She is not a medical doctor and must never be referred to as "Dr".
- Dr. Ashish Shahane, Ayurveda Consultant. BAMS (Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery). Ayurvedic protocols.
- Bhupendra Goud, Head Nutritionist. ISSA Certified Nutritionist. Reviews nutrition content.
- Ajay Mohanlal Gaud and Pooja Doshi, founders.

## What Let's Conceive does

Supports couples trying to conceive naturally, including those with PCOS (now called PMOS), low AMH, thyroid imbalance, irregular periods, poor egg quality, insulin resistance and hormonal imbalance, as well as couples after unsuccessful IVF or IUI cycles. The approach addresses four pillars: hormonal signalling optimisation, reproductive cell quality, internal environment restoration covering gut health and inflammation, and emotional readiness. Both partners are supported. Delivery is virtual.

## Programs

- The Accelerator, self-paced: learning portal, templates, weekly group Q&amp;A, community access.
- The Inner Circle, consulting: everything in Accelerator plus bi-weekly 1-on-1 calls, custom nutrition and supplement plan, psychological counseling sessions, doctor network access.
- Private Client, done-for-you: weekly doctor consultations, full concierge support, partner coaching.
- Cost: a fraction of a single IVF cycle. IVF in India runs roughly 1.5 to 4 lakh rupees per attempt.

## Facts

- Founded after co-founder Pooja Doshi's miscarriage, to address the gap in preparing the body before trying to conceive.
- Over 4,000 couples guided across 6 countries.
- Focus is natural conception preparation where medically appropriate. It complements, and never replaces, medical care.
- Contact: support@letsconceive.in | WhatsApp +91 8999313721
- Registered location: Amravati, Maharashtra, India
